subject: Kickoff: bi-tempered loss as the default robust training loss
body:
Team,

Kicking off the bi-tempered loss productization for trust-theory. The pitch: customers keep training on noisy labels and blaming the platform. The bi-tempered logistic loss gives us a bounded per-sample loss plus a heavy-tail softmax, and since it recovers plain cross entropy at t1 = t2 = 1.0, we can ship it as a drop-in default with zero regression risk when temperatures are neutral.

Goal for the window (Apr 20 - Jul 20): a vetted implementation + temperature-tuning guidance, benchmarked on our noisy-label suites, ready for a Launch Review Board slot in mid-July.

Milestones: M1 (May 15) implementation parity with the open-source release incl. the bias-correction term; M2 (Jun 19) benchmark matrix across label-noise levels; M3 (Jul 13) LRB packet.

Yara is TL, Rafael co-leads the theory review. Bao will follow with staffing.

Ximena
